_readme: Which documents students must upload for program applications. Rules merge in order: default -> byEducationLevel[program's eligible level] -> byProgram[program name]. A later entry with the same documentType replaces an earlier one (so a program can make a default document optional, or change its notes). documentType must be one of: Passport, OfferLetter, Certificate, ProfilePhoto, Other. byEducationLevel keys: Undergraduate, Graduate, PostGraduate. byProgram keys must match the program name exactly as staff created it (case-insensitive).

default.label: Profile photo
default.notes: Clear, recent, front-facing photo with a plain background.

default.label: Latest academic certificate / mark sheet
default.notes: Your most recent qualification certificate or final mark sheet.

default.label: Passport
default.notes: Required for international students and for programs that involve travel. Upload the photo/details page.

Undergraduate.label: Higher secondary (Class 12) certificate or mark sheet
Undergraduate.notes: Upload the Class 12 / higher secondary pass certificate or final mark sheet.

Graduate.label: Bachelor's degree certificate or final transcript
Graduate.notes: Upload your bachelor's degree certificate, or the final-year mark sheet if the degree certificate is not issued yet.

PostGraduate.label: Master's degree certificate or final transcript
PostGraduate.notes: Upload your master's degree certificate or final transcripts.

Student Exchange Program.label: Passport
Student Exchange Program.notes: A passport valid for at least 6 months beyond the exchange period.

Student Exchange Program.label: Offer letter from the host institution
Student Exchange Program.notes: The admission/offer letter issued by the partner institution.
